headlines.title: Wilshere v Ramsey - Arsenal legends treading similar managerial paths
headlines.description: Eighteen years after making their Premier League debuts two minutes apart, Jack Wilshere and Aaron Ramsey meet as managers.

headlines.title: Champions League to be a factor in Paz move - Saturday's gossip
headlines.description: Manchester United may lose the chance to sign Nico Paz without Champions League qualification, Arsenal also want the Como midfielder and Liverpool eye Lamine Camara.

headlines.title: 'I am not a magician' - what can Maresca's Man City learn from watertight Arsenal?
headlines.description: Manchester City's leaky defence faces one of the most difficult games of the season with a trip to watertight Arsenal, aiming to put right their patchy recent form.
